Definition: from G5384 and G2316; fond of God, i.e. pious:--lover of God.
BiblicalUsage: Philothoes means a lover of God, pious, and it appears once, in the list of the last days, as the thing men have traded away. Men shall be lovers of pleasures more than lovers of God, having a form of godliness but denying the power thereof.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the lover of God is the one thing the last days lose: pleasure takes His place, and a form of godliness is left with no power in it.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
